status: INTERNAL REVIEW SYSTEM / DISPLAY STYLING ONLY / NO ENGINEERING UPLIFT
objective: Make the complete CGX/Römer technology stack reviewable as one coherent product/engineering family from component and printable 4D stack through subsystem, mission module and facility while preserving source geometry and evidence boundaries.
authority_order: exact user/corpus geometry and object identity
source mesh / parametric packet / CGXI state

brand.logo_policy: Text lockup only until an approved vector emblem/logo is present in canon; never invent or distort a mark.
brand.specificity: Dark technical field + teal corpus/data accent + restrained gold/green hierarchy. Object identity and evidence state remain more prominent than decorative effects.

hero.camera: three-quarter technical product view; approximately normal/55 mm visual perspective without aggressive wide-angle distortion
hero.lighting: display-only three-point technical lighting: cool key, restrained fill, subtle rim; no claimed physical material response
hero.composition: one primary focal object; 6–8% safe margins; active negative space for object name/evidence badge
hero.use: internal design review and later showcase candidate after publication gate

interactive.geometry: source-hashed derived mesh payload; orbit/zoom only
interactive.styling: same display-only shaded palette as hero
interactive.use: internal geometry/twin inspection; no editing or machine authority

material_policy: visual shading is a display treatment only
do not infer metallic, composite, ceramic, glass, coating or surface finish from display shading
where exact material stack is source-bound, show it as text/evidence overlay before considering physically faithful material rendering
hard_vetoes: hidden geometry added solely for aesthetics
source silhouette or proportions materially changed
physical completion implied by render quality
performance, safety, certification or mission readiness inferred from appearance
showcase publication before owner publication gate
qa: evidence badge readable at review resolution
brand-off test: Römer/Cognigrex palette/evidence grammar remains specific even without a logo
AI-slop veto: no ornamental pipes, seams, vents, fasteners or panels unless present in source/corpus geometry
